title: ARSIA Discovery Response
description: AgentMetadata object returned by the discovery endpoint (GET /.well-known/arsia). Describes an agent's identity, protocol support, capabilities, rate limits, and compliance profile support. Defined in ARSIA-Core.md §7.1.

name.description: Human-readable display name of the agent. Per ARSIA-Core.md §7.1.

version.description: The agent's software version (e.g. '2.1.0'). Per ARSIA-Core.md §7.1.

protocol_version.description: The ARSIA protocol version supported (e.g. '1.0'). Per ARSIA-Core.md §7.1.

inbox.description: Absolute URL of the agent's inbox endpoint (ARSIA-Core.md §8.1). Per ARSIA-Core.md §7.1.

jwks.description: Absolute URL of the agent's JWKS endpoint (ARSIA-Core.md §7.3). Per ARSIA-Core.md §7.1.

capabilities_supported.description: Array of capability strings that this agent accepts. Per ARSIA-Core.md §7.1.

max_message_bytes.description: Maximum message size in bytes that this agent accepts. Per ARSIA-Core.md §7.1.

request_timeout_ms.description: Maximum time in milliseconds that this agent will spend processing a request before timing out. Per ARSIA-Core.md §7.1.

server_min.description: Minimum ARSIA protocol version this agent supports (e.g. '1.0'). Per ARSIA-Core.md §7.1.

server_max.description: Maximum ARSIA protocol version this agent supports (e.g. '1.0'). Per ARSIA-Core.md §7.1.

features.description: Feature flags indicating optional protocol support. Per ARSIA-Core.md §7.1.

async_responses.description: Whether the agent supports asynchronous responses (HTTP 202). Per ARSIA-Core.md §7.1.

batch_requests.description: Whether the agent supports batch request processing. Per ARSIA-Core.md §7.1.

encryption.description: Whether the agent supports payload encryption (ARSIA-Core.md §5.3). Per ARSIA-Core.md §7.1.

requests_per_minute.description: Maximum number of requests accepted per minute. Per ARSIA-Core.md §7.1.

burst_size.description: Maximum number of requests accepted in a burst. Per ARSIA-Core.md §7.1.

compliance_profiles_supported.description: Array of compliance profile name strings that this agent can apply when processing messages (e.g. ['EU-AI-ACT-HIGH-RISK', 'MIFID-II']). Per ARSIA-Core.md §7.1.
